evidence.quote: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent

The Committee anticipates that ongoing increases in the target range will be appropriate in order to attain a stance of monetary policy that is sufficiently restrictive to return inflation to 2 percent over time.
Inflation has eased somewhat but remains elevated.
Job gains have been robust in recent months, and the unemployment rate has remained low.
The Committee is highly attentive to inflation risks.
the Committee will continue reducing its holdings of Treasury securities and agency debt and agency mortgage-backed securities
